target.title: fix: show exported tool results in trace viewers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users inspecting OpenClaw traces in LLM trace viewers could see tool-result rows without the result body when the viewer expected standard message/content fields or GenAI tool-call span attributes.

Related context: local Phoenix traces showed tool result cards with no visible output because tool response text was nested under `tool_call_response` parts instead of top-level tool message content.

## Why This Change Was Made

The OTEL exporter now derives Phoenix/OpenInference-readable `content` and `tool_call_id` for tool response messages while preserving the original structured parts. Tool execution spans also mirror explicitly captured tool inputs/results to `gen_ai.tool.call.arguments` and `gen_ai.tool.call.result`, with `gen_ai.tool.call.id` on spans, so OTEL-native viewers such as Opik, Langfuse, and OpenLIT can display tool I/O without relying on OpenClaw-private attribute names.

AI-assisted.

## User Impact

Operators can inspect future OpenClaw traces and see captured tool results in Phoenix-style chat views and standard GenAI tool span views, provided `diagnostics.otel.captureContent.toolInputs/toolOutputs` is enabled. Existing traces are not rewritten.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.ts extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
